g.text: Root Lock Lockdown not applied active for 103d 10h Backup: not configured
Maintenance runs with Lockdown not applied, so only your maintenance
connection should stay reachable while you work.
2 ports still listening: HTTP on port 80 and HTTPS on port 443. Their services will be stopped when maintenance begins. Press
Root login is off and password login is off.
Optional but recommended: limit SSH to known source addresses or a VPN.
